clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem sends warrior aspirants south to face an unfamiliar foe. They must slay silithid in the Field of Giants and return with several twitching antennae within half an hour.

At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem challenges growing warriors to prove themselves against an unfamiliar adversary. The Horde's warrior trainers test more than combat skill: aspirants must slay the creatures and bring back fresh antennae within half an hour. The run across the southern Barrens tests their speed and resolve, while the antennae must still twitch when they reach Taurajo.

Silithid hives rise in the Field of Giants, beneath massive fossilized ribcages. The bizarre, crawling insects are recent arrivals in the Barrens, disturbing tauren hunters and shamans who watch the savannas. Ruga says their presence bodes ill for Kalimdor. The trial tests a young warrior's instincts in combat and gathers intelligence on a growing threat to the land.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants. There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures. They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.
Bring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, friend, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long. Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the antennae? If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nicely done, friend! In passing the trial at the Field of Giants, you take one more step down the adventurer's path.
